"""Owned independent gate probes; no product/model/source-catalog work."""
import ast
import io
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from tools import pre_push_gate as gate

EXPECTED_GATE = Path("C:/Users/郑曾波/Projects/company-wiki/tmp/w23-r6/tools/pre_push_gate.py")
assert Path(gate.__file__).resolve() == EXPECTED_GATE.resolve(), gate.__file__


def git(root, *args):
    p = subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=root, capture_output=True,
                       text=True, encoding="utf-8", timeout=20)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr
    return p.stdout.strip()


def test_actual_multi_ref_paths_never_hide_source(monkeypatch, tmp_path, capsys):
    git(tmp_path, "init", "-q", "-b", "master")
    git(tmp_path, "config", "user.name", "Independent reviewer")
    git(tmp_path, "config", "user.email", "review@example.invalid")
    (tmp_path / "README.md").write_text("base", encoding="utf-8")
    git(tmp_path, "add", ".")
    git(tmp_path, "commit", "-qm", "base")
    baseline = git(tmp_path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
    (tmp_path / "engine.py").write_text("pass\n", encoding="utf-8")
    git(tmp_path, "add", ".")
    git(tmp_path, "commit", "-qm", "source")
    code = git(tmp_path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
    (tmp_path / "README.md").write_text("after code", encoding="utf-8")
    git(tmp_path, "add", ".")
    git(tmp_path, "commit", "-qm", "docs")
    docs = git(tmp_path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
    update = (f"refs/heads/a {code} refs/heads/a {baseline}\n"
              f"refs/heads/b {docs} refs/heads/b {code}\n")
    assert gate.changed_paths(tmp_path, update) == {"engine.py", "README.md"}
    monkeypatch.setattr(gate, "PROJECT_ROOT", tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(gate.sys, "stdin", io.StringIO(update))
    calls = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(gate, "_run_pytest_gate", lambda cmd, label: calls.append(cmd) or 0)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ast, "parse", lambda *a, **k: (_ for _ in ()).throw(AssertionError("AST used")))
    assert gate.main(["--push-checks"]) == 0
    assert len(calls) == 1
    assert calls[0][calls[0].index("--timeout=180") + 1:] == list(gate.FAST_CONTRACT_CASES)
    out = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert "fixed smoke only" in out and "full_validation_pending" in out


def test_unknown_and_executable_docs_are_not_skipped(monkeypatch, capsys):
    for paths in ({"docs/runtime.py"}, {"docs/README.json"},
                  {".github/workflows/ci.yml"}, {"unseen.bundle"}, None):
        monkeypatch.setattr(gate, "changed_paths", lambda *a, p=paths: p)
        monkeypatch.setattr(gate.sys, "stdin", io.StringIO("independent"))
        calls = []
        monkeypatch.setattr(gate, "_run_pytest_gate", lambda cmd, label: calls.append(cmd) or 7)
        assert gate.main(["--push-checks"]) == 7
        assert len(calls) == 1
        out = capsys.readouterr().out
        assert "PUSH CHECKS RED" in out and "local_fast_pass" not in out


def test_daily_actual_child_bound_and_cleanup(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    short_root = Path(__file__).parent / "s"
    assert not short_root.exists()
    short_root.mkdir()
    monkeypatch.setattr(gate, "PROJECT_ROOT", tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(gate, "_scratch_candidate_roots", lambda: [str(short_root)])
    seen = []

    def run(cmd, label, timeout, env_extra):
        scratch = Path(cmd[cmd.index("--basetemp") + 1])
        assert scratch.exists()
        seen.append(scratch)
        assert timeout == 180
        assert gate.STDOUT_CAP_BYTES == 4 * 1024 * 1024
        assert gate.STDERR_CAP_BYTES == 512 * 1024
        assert env_extra["TEMP"] == str(scratch.resolve())
        assert env_extra["TMP"] == str(scratch.resolve())
        assert env_extra["SQLITE_TMPDIR"] == str(scratch.resolve())
        assert cmd.count("-vv") == 1
        assert "no:cacheprovider" in cmd
        (scratch / "partial").write_text("owned", encoding="utf-8")
        return 7

    monkeypatch.setattr(gate, "_run", run)
    assert gate._run_pytest_gate(["fixture"], gate.DAILY_PUSH_LABEL_PREFIX + " probe") == 7
    assert len(seen) == 1 and not seen[0].exists()
    assert not list(tmp_path.iterdir())
    assert not list(short_root.iterdir())
    short_root.rmdir()
